headlines.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
headlines.summary: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide,…

concept.title: Hallucinations & Reliability
concept.body: Models can state false things with total confidence because they optimise for plausible text, not truth. Reliability comes from grounding, verification steps, and human review.
concept.takeaway: For anything customer- or board-facing, design a checking step; never ship raw model output unverified.
